download-mission-map-unload-stock.head: 1296d405d4fde07ddd0a1263a68687cc53f2b04b
download-mission-map-unload-stock.scope: Stock mission acceptance produced a 3 s objective ping. PacketLog pr393 lines 1602–2048 show the refresh before native unload. Reload does not refresh the old outcome. After abort and a new acceptance the new location marker appears from line 2853. This covers the packet sequence on the locked-safe mission.
